Fernleaf Flowers

Seasonal flowers arranged by hand in our little Ripon studio, delivered across North Yorkshire every Tuesday and Friday.

About us

We are a two-person studio who grow half of what we sell on a plot outside the city. Everything else comes from British growers we know by name.

No floral foam, no plastic wrap: every bouquet is tied with twine and wrapped in recycled paper.

  • See our wedding work

Weddings

From a single buttonhole to an arch of meadow flowers, we plan wedding flowers with you over a pot of tea.

  • A first visit to talk colours and seasons
  • A trial posy a month before the day
  • Set-up and clearing away on the day

Wedding packages start from £450.
